name: Chat
description: Mechanism for sending messages: press send -> dispatch -> show message but text as 'sending...' -> setSent -> dislay full text
access: Registered with require('Chat', 'Uxi', 'Touch'). OML addresses it as selector:Chat. Call the methods on the instance. Method names are not OML keys.
